_about: Client-level facts that hold across every report for this client. Read at intake from the project folder, confirmed in the one intake question, written back by package.py at delivery. Per-report facts (PlanGrid project, building, walk date, issuance date, scope) are never stored here.
_sheet_titles: {"T01-01": "TECHNOLOGY SITE PLAN", ...}. The MCP pull returns no sheet list and the Task Report prints only the sheet number, so without this map the report shows the number alone. Fill it once per project; adapt_mcp_pull.py applies it.
_cover_mode: template (generate -Cover.docx for review) | supplied (reviewer's own cover) | blank | none
_client_logo: path to a PNG of the client's logo if one is on hand; copied to build/assets/cover/client_logo.png. Usually not available; leave null.
